items.title: Paul Barbarin Interview, 1960-01-28
items.q: I think Chip was the leader at that time. Chip. You know Chip the trumpet player, he also played bass too.

ctx.x: No, not both of them together, no, I mean I heard Bailey with the same band and I thought he was a wonderful drummer. Who was the leader of the band? I think Chip was the leader at that time. Chip. You know Chip the trumpet player, he also played bass too. I think he's racking ball on Ramport Street, I don't know.
